notes.title: New Vehicle Physics and Collision System Now Live
notes.content:
Vehicle Physics Update v0.6.7Better Handling, Smarter Collisions, and More Control Behind the Wheel
We work on Plains of Pain every single day, and we mean it. Every bug you report, every suggestion you drop, every strange moment you post or stream — we’re watching, reading, and building around it.

This update is a direct answer to what the community has been asking for. Vehicles now feel dramatically better. Driving is smoother. Collisions are smarter. And the frustrating bugs around movement and terrain are finally being crushed under the wheels.

It’s a new experience behind the wheel, and it’s just the beginning.

[previewyoutube=l31AmMMp8kY;full][/previewyoutube]

Vehicle Overhaul  New vehicle physics system
  Driving now feels weightier, more grounded, and reactive to terrain. The weird sinking? Gone. The loose floaty feel? Replaced with proper handling. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/e7d998f872ef1c6c6ba814f8c3bb39f430fdbbe3.gif

 Reworked collision logic
  Crashes now behave more predictably. No more glitchy bounces or random stuck moments when hitting terrain.  Fixed endless black smoke issue
  Your ride should only smoke when it's supposed to. Now it behaves correctly after repairs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/404d6c9c37db508c7dc0c91f8c9a846e1d10f29a.jpg

Content Updates  Repair Intel improvements
  Repair items used through the Repair Intel system are now more effective. Less waste, better durability gains.  Melee weapons now deal damage even at 0 percent condition
  They behave as if at 10 percent condition, letting you finish a fight even with a busted blade.  Updated 3D model for bandit loot containers
  The bandit stash containers in the wasteland now look sharper and more in line with our current visual direction.  Post-Apo Badass skill buffed
  The maximum health boost from this skill has been increased from 200 percent to 300 percent. You can now build a true tank.  Frank and Ron got updated 3D models
  Two of the most recognizable faces in the early game now look even better. Same heart, more polish. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/0cdfb22167e18cc77911d59e579c99b2854be5f9.jpg
Fixes  Fixed an issue with the slot machine glitch  Fixed a bug with the Bandit Chieftain kill quest not progressing  Fixed multiple quest destination bugs affecting:
      Frank and Ron camp
      Ammo Ace Jackson farm
      Fat Mike’s Junkyard  Fixed US unit display in Vehicle Manager  Fixed US unit display in 3D screen custom points  Fixed missing interaction for TOS LuxerWe Build This With You
Every system we touch, every model we redo, every percentage we tweak — it’s all driven by your voice. Your experience in the wasteland is what matters most, and every patch is shaped by the way you play, explore, and survive.

We’re not building this alone. We’re building this with you.
From the Dev Team
Thank you for being here. For supporting us. For pushing us to do better. This community is something special, and we never take that for granted.

This update is one more step on the road to version 1.0

More is coming. And we can’t wait to show you what’s next.

Stay sharp
Your Plains of Pain Dev Team

notes.title: Pages from the Wasteland: Bandit Records
notes.content:
These notes were found in a weathered journal, scribbled by a survivor who has seen too much.  
Read them well — they might keep you alive.
Random Basic Bandit CampsWandering through the wasteland, you may stumble upon small bandit camps.  
They are usually guarded by Scum, Runner, and Needle. Sometimes, a Chieftan joins them.  
Crates and tents in these camps often hide valuable loot — but don’t underestimate even the weakest bandits.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/88c84815f0696f235be0a621f55d53a863fcb89e.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/62940ef956578f4888447bcaeefa32ea6ccdb40c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/0853666113e58cd465842a7b3b4dfc1e6fe0f6f4.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/6155474b8bceb3949348499e3d7a8968cbdfd7ed.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/13daf5ca836dd1e32b6ecbbb85765b13d68dc37f.png"]

Bandit StacksLarger bandit strongholds, built from scavenged metal and rage.  
Here you’ll meet the same foes as in basic camps, but also Fixer, Peeker, and Boomy.  
A direct approach is deadly. If you hear laughter behind your back — run.  
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/334479433f40228aea7bccf1d8d345b378357052.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/57ff849a82e9e54f356e3ed6c6f02b274dd540af.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/1c8de623ff2d62df6d38f602a39d40bd0c776737.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/58a87167dbdee22792a99a17d99fcea00fb3df0e.png"]

Random Advanced Bandit CampsThe deeper you go into the wasteland, the nastier the camps become.  
These groups are often reinforced with Fixer, Baghead, and Perimeter.  
Sometimes even Boomy or Mr. Cleaner show up to make things worse.  
Only go in prepared. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/b96743a20d4d8d9c4b22205ef888d9f8840573c1.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/c46a04eb46f8285388848e369288c4948173eb4b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/07ed5f1a9614a5cc309055f15e8270f47ad67a07.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/be1394fcf2ffdb0d305a5f144df9a3cb4891bd74.png"]

Bandit Stacks II.
Few dare to enter these places.  
All of the bloodiest bandits gather here — and towering above them is Lord Baron, who rules with brutality.  
It’s high risk, but the loot is unmatched. Enter only if you’re ready to pay the price.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/449b76919e5003a662db844586a5256e1bc426ef.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/c220a858b1fc8875d066f14392e9f1ef6b5d8e06.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/1ef867286a2d72883b5e2b500dc471ee4ce943f2.png"]
End of notes. Whoever wrote them may not have survived… but their words live on in the dust.

notes.title: Wastelander’s Handbook – Dev Tips & Tricks #1
notes.content:
Hey Wastelanders, 
We know Plains of Pain is a complex game.  
Even though we’ve built in an onboarding system with tutorial quests, some things are still easier when told straight.  
That’s why we’ve gathered these developer tips & tricks to help you survive longer in the wasteland.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/7116033949d9b3766f68edd03fb362ca44df6669.jpg

Follow the Tutorial Quests
If you’re new, don’t skip them. They guide you through early crafting and survival steps — the best way to start.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/356ff946ac942f99512d1c2da41e88dc532ccef4.jpg

Choose the Right Difficulty

 Tourist – Best for first-timers.  
 Rookie – Faster progression, still fair.  
 True Wastelander, Veteran, Overlord – Only for hardcore survivors who want real punishment.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/e67a9200ec7afce5f577e7178497f7951408a770.jpg"]

Set a Safe Camp
Make a tiny camp where you operate. A Stone Stash and Mattress are a good start.  
Use the mattress to set your spawn point — so death won’t send you too far away.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/b3a188c0e5e4ffa013f71a09519b8df73917c3e3.jpg"]

Salvage the Wrecks
Use a Stone Hammer on vehicle wrecks scattered across the wasteland.  
They provide metal resources and, rarely, vehicle parts.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/d39d36d11f7ba5bca4b5789a5b89c6f3e1b48f15.jpg"]

Base Building Basics
Always start with a Foundation.  
Only then build platforms and walls — snapping works exclusively when a foundation is placed first.  
(We know this trips up some players, so we’re planning to improve it.)  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/bad9e12ea123fc4f41e16992d7b8011990c7a914.jpg"]

World Size Matters

S or M worlds – Faster progression, closer locations.  
L to XXL worlds – Endless desolation, tougher survival. Combine with Overlord difficulty for a real nightmare.  

Repair and Maintain Your Gear
Repair options (Repair Intel) appear below item description when condition drops under 50%. It shows what items to use for repairing. Use them in a same way as i.e. Whetstone (drag and drop with RMB)
High condition = maximum damage output.
- Oil or Crude Oil → repair firearms.  
- Whetstone → repair melee weapons multiple times
- Makeshift Repair Kit → repair both multiple times.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/ca7694a32d0f4985804324b73af73a511dc1488b.jpg"]

Skills and Strategy
Focus your skill set on short-term goals.  
You can re-roll skills a few times to change your entire build — very strategic if used wisely.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/7227025467723ce6d2e9bf45118aea6d2009aee4.jpg

Before You Build Big
Avoid heavy base building until you craft any bigger Backpack.  
It will let you gather resources much faster.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/83b584a4c6c67e39e18264480caa9f13fa1a7b6e.jpg

Vehicles
Build vehicles near Junkyards or Bandit Stacks — both are great spots to loot vehicle parts.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/4db0409a69a3db6db7d92a09fbf3dffdb7f97acb.jpg

Guns from Bandits
If you want firearms fast, head for the Bandit Stacks.  
Difficulty decides whether it’s a treasure hunt… or a suicide mission.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/7a9728a7591e2c16945133fe6b5669b121e97b27.jpg

We’ll keep sharing more insider tips as Plains of Pain grows.  
Until then — stay alive, stay sharp, and don’t trust the wasteland.

notes.title: The Road Ahead – Plains of Pain Development Update
notes.content:
Greetings Wastelanders,
Plains of Pain is evolving fast. Our development is dynamic – sometimes impulsive, sometimes shaped by your feedback, but always true to our vision. That’s why we don’t want to promise exact dates.
Instead, we want to show you the directions the game is heading.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/b0df7e41822a6f54bf6b4c608bdc5fb12a809797.png
Almost Finished (currently in testing)

 Ukrainian language support.
 New vehicle physics – more realistic handling, bigger differences between vehicles, and most importantly, a fix for sinking-through-the-ground issues.
 New 3D models for Frank and Ron (NPCs in the starting area).

Currently in Development

 Completely new OGD unit models.
 Completely new TOS unit models.

 Big Goals Ahead  
  
 Steam community content – cards, achievements, emoticons.  
 Improved network code for the Building System → unlocking unlimited building potential.  
 The legendary city The Lost Wings City – with a brand new storyline.  
 Questlines for well-known NPCs: Ammo Ace Jackson, Fat Mike, Ruxxie, Fallen Frank.  

 Planned (further goals, step by step as possible)  
  
 Server Dev Tools (custom server moderation).  
 Improved Cargo Delivery system (dynamic quests, more diverse supply and demand).  
 Improved Combat System.  
 New building sets (walls, floors, skins, better properties).  
 New vehicles.  
 Replacing old 3D models with new ones
 New buildable storages.  
 New production buildings for settlements.  
 New trader locations.  
 New abandoned areas and buildings with loot spread across the wasteland.  
 New weapons.
 New random quests.
 New skills and skill quests.
 New global events (following Overheat and Meteor Shower).  
 New quest and crafting items.  
 More types of crafting stations (beyond Anvil, Workbench, Campfire).  
 Hidden city of the Lowlifes.  
 Migrating Lowlife hordes attacking the locations in the world.  
 Bandits’ Black Market – special trade location for bandit members.  
 New playable characters.  
 Underground complexes with mysteries and secrets.  
 More settlements – rebuildable/expandable, with unique resources.  
 More faction outposts and locations for Faction Wars.  
 Global faction wars (map) – multiplayer clashes between OGD, TOS, Bandits, and Dustborns.  
 Expanded reputation system.  
 New biomes.  
 Entirely new maps.  
 New sounds and music.  
 New faction battle robots, drones and mechs.
 New wildlife animals.
 Hunting and collecting valuable artifacts.
 A storyline (quests) revealing the full truth about what turned the world into a wasteland.
 More languages support (Polish, Russian, Korean, Chinese, Japanese)

 In the End  
This is not a strict schedule, but our compass. Some features will come sooner, others later, and some ideas we’re keeping secret – to surprise you.

Thank you for shaping the wasteland with us. Plains of Pain will keep growing – and this is only the beginning.

notes.title: Major Bandit Update with New Models and Unique Voices
notes.content:
Major Update – Bandits Update v0.6.6New Faces, New Voices, New Threats
This is a big one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/546cd3956c7103a596988d1bbe7311fc7d19fbed.jpg

We’ve completely reimagined the bandit faction in Plains of Pain. After months of focused work and collaboration with voice actors, we're proud to introduce 11 brand-new bandit 3D models, each remodeled by our team in our signature visual style, and paired with their own unique voice.

They’re meaner, sharper, and fully integrated into the world visually and sonically.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/fd1c118806a57eb128d5a9623b2523ee56cd7bf8.jpg
You’ll hear them shout, mumble, and threaten. If you’re quiet enough, you might even notice how their voices change at night. Every bandit now feels like a distinct character. And every fight feels a little more personal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/c42c4c9ecfbfd2a0da3411bd6dd642ab49fd6913.jpg
Major Additions  11 Remodeled Bandit Characters
  All bandits have been rebuilt by our team in our signature Plains of Pain style. These new models carry more attitude, visual identity, and danger than ever before. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/d24ae3fcd7644a60ff20d7436f06cc67510b0a4f.jpg
 11 Unique Bandit Voiceovers
  Each bandit comes with their own voice, recorded with professional voice actors. No more generic grunts. Now they taunt, growl, and react in immersive ways.  Dynamic Audio Based on Time
  Bandits sound different at night if you listen from a distance. It’s subtle. It's creepy. It’s intentional.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/01e9da465ed6b71192a64a7afd67dcb8d220ad1e.jpg
New Features & Improvements  Reworked Bandit Loot Tables
  Bandits drop better and more fitting loot. You asked, we delivered.  New Loot Container in Bandit Stacks (Lord Baron’s Box)
  A special locked stash has been added to the second bandit location. Find Lord Baron, get the key, reap the rewards.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/c743aa1f7f95c9d0dcec6b570813bfc47a206acb.jpg
  Bandits Repro Audio System (and Explosive Surprise)
  Some bandit lairs now have active music systems. You can shoot them down, but be careful. They're rigged to blow.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/300905b76248ae81cc500019d64c27c8bfa30aac.jpg 
 
Chupacabra Audio Overhaul
  We’ve fully replaced its old sounds with something more natural and more unnerving.Crafting & Repair Overhaul  New Item: Makeshift Repair Kit
  Repair both melee weapons and firearms with a craftable item. Flexible and practical.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/54f5ee3303663c27756027287720a463cad1f454.jpg

  Repair Intel System
  When a weapon’s condition drops below 50%, the item description will now show you exactly how you can repair it. Use specific parts (like an iron pipe) to restore durability step-by-step. We’ve added more depth and flexibility to the repair system without making it a grind.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/446673622ce88401799884dcb604329b90006279.jpg
Gameplay Changes  Air-Dropped Bandit Containers Are Now Locked
  You’ll need to find keys from the Bandit Chieftain and Lord Baron to unlock them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/8d78ced4b53f9f38c6a2eadd37eece21700216df.jpg
Fixes  Meteor impact damage now works as intended.  Fixed vehicle black smoke not respecting distance fog.  Fixed incorrect inventory weight calculation when:          Repairing a gun with oil      Mixing liquids      Poisoning a melee weapon      Repairing with a Whetstone      
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/a3cb2950fe343cc0b4a252f781621492519100a7.jpg

We’re Building This Together
We’ve poured everything into this update. From completely remodeling the bandits to giving them their own personalities through voice and behavior, this is one of the biggest steps forward for Plains of Pain so far.

We listen to your feedback. We watch your streams. We read your comments, bug reports, and ideas. Every bit of it helps shape what comes next.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/0d3ab887ff58aebb4d6016f55d8da3bacf033d74.jpg

From the Dev Team
Thank you for your continued support, for pushing us, and for keeping this world alive with your energy.

This update is a huge milestone, but it’s only the beginning. The road to 1.0 is still ahead and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.

Stay dangerous
Your Plains of Pain Dev Team

notes.title: Hotfix v0.6.5.16 + New Online Command
notes.content:
Greetings, Wastelanders!

We’ve added a new online command to give you more control over your character slots:
[code]/rmslot N[/code]Where N is the online slot ID (1, 2, or 3).

You can use this command while playing online to remove one of your character slots from the remote host — perfect if you want to start fresh with a new character.

For example, to remove Online Slot 1:  

 Connect to the server (or remote host).
 Open the in-game chat.
 Type: [code]/rmslot 1[/code]
In the future, we plan to add a proper UI for this action. But for now — while the game is still in alpha — we wanted to make this tool available because it can be very useful.

Other Fixes:

 Resolved several minor bugs.
 Fixed a rare issue where Bobby Winado could be cloned at Ammo Ace Jackson’s farm.

Enjoy your weekend in the Wasteland!

notes.title: Hotfix v0.6.4.16
notes.content:
Greetings, Wastelanders!  
We hope you had a blast during your weekend adventures. We held off on this hotfix so we wouldn't interrupt your playtime — but now it's here!

What's fixed and improved:


Equipment Slot Fixes  
We’ve resolved a critical issue that prevented certain items — especially shoulder armor and traverses — from being properly assigned to equip slots.
Custom POI in Restricted Areas  
Players can now place custom Points of Interest (POIs) even inside faction-restricted zones or Safe Zones. No more limitations when marking the map!
Better Onboarding for New Players  
We’ve made a few tweaks to make the early game smoother:

A Whetstone is now included in your starting inventory — introducing the item and showing what it’s good for.  
Garlic has been added to Ron’s barter list to help with early crafting of healing items.  
A new control hint appears next to the Storage UI (e.g. when opening a Stone Stash), showing new players how to access the Craftbook directly from Storage — using both their own and stash inventory at once.
New Loot for Yesman Lowlifes  
Yesman lowlifes now drop their own unique loot pool — expect more rags, metal balls, and Ballguns. A fresh way to gather essentials while roaming the wasteland!

Thanks for your continued support. More updates are on the horizon — stay sharp out there!

notes.title: Plains of Pain v0.6.4 – Dust Rolls In, Games Roll Out
notes.content:
Winds Shift, Pockets Fill, and Bobby Walks Away
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/8bea664ecc9a11427ac35a9cf342e7050549c998.jpg
The desert doesn't rest, and neither do we. This update brings a wave of useful fixes, fresh features, and subtle changes that make life in the wasteland a little more intense — and a little more survivable. From visual upgrades to smarter inventory behavior, and from new combat feedback to the temporary farewell of the Wasteland Games, patch 0.6.4 is all about refining your fight under the scorched sky.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/04c1d3e487059bb4ea424cb5c82b4cee82494ce3.jpg
New Features  Player Damage Numbers
  You can now toggle visible damage numbers in the Settings. Turn them on to track every hit — or off to keep it clean and immersive.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/5c375b0a8553a8be5cca305c443fa757176ea120.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/5a96445f25e1b719abdbab9d4d0d1036ea476906.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/c8d161f7b10b9354f453bb532f9d88be1d2f8fab.jpg
 Two New Hotbar Slots
  By default, your hotbar now includes two additional slots for faster, more flexible loadouts.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/98a9fc96cf6ac7861d98eee8235bad277c8f2800.jpg
 
 Windy Dust Effect
  A new random environmental effect adds dusty gusts to your travels, enriching the atmosphere.  Experimental Heat Distortion
  A shimmering visual effect simulates extreme heat waves. Optional in Settings. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/3900989edb723fdea0b34bb97ed50c6cd556c264.png

 Bug Report Button
  Found directly in the main menu — letting you report bugs faster and easier.  Whetstone Merge
  You can now merge multiple Whetstones into one to consolidate condition.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/f594156fac556b579938f2b5662e0c757260abef.jpg
Fixes and Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/687eefd2fd98b7668a33436c55bd63ba5c3b09be.jpg
  Fixed an issue where you couldn't craft using stacks larger than 255.  Death-Proof Pocket now always appears at the top of your inventory.  Fixed bugged storage containers and UI freezing in inventory.  Fixed custom crosshair colors resetting.  Fixed item transfer from storage to inventory not working properly.  Fixed overly small lootable animal corpses.  Fixed TOS units aiming too high with guns.  Fixed too-small no-build zones around underground hideouts.  Fixed quest text referencing Frank instead of Ammo Ace Jackson.  Improved item pickup priority when looting: backpack and waist bag are now used first, keeping your Death-Proof Pocket for what matters most.  Fixed LOD distances for Nopal plants.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/30d26ee44cb393531b47c379799df7b57cc5adee.jpg
Visual Updates  Updated 3D models for the Plastic Bottle and Old Oil Flacon.  Fat Mike now has a new model — same junkyard boss, sharper look.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/44912a8446a0369bf0bc87c568d091498c1f9181.jpg
Wasteland Games – A Pause, Not an End
The Wasteland Games have ended for now, but their mark remains.

Bobby Winado has left Frank and Ron’s camp. You’ll now find him at Ammo Ace Jackson’s Farm, where he’ll still accept your remaining WG Chips for trade. While the desert yeti, escaped clones, and chupacabra still roam, they no longer drop WG Chips.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/332974bfef780124e7e0fbb2b3433ee5d3e2eeb5.jpg

The only transport still moving them is the golden truck — keep an eye on it if you're hunting down the last bits of WG loot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/7364ff96eb67caf96ce43252ce158632d2c1d9f3.jpg

The Games will return. When? No one knows. But they’re not gone forever.

If you’ve hit the limit, consider moving to a more remote area where fewer players have built. Starting your base out there can give you more freedom and better performance.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.6.0.92
notes.content:
Hotfix v0.6.0.92 is live, Wastelanders!

We’ve patched up a few sneaky bugs and added some improvements to keep the wasteland running smoother than ever.

Hotfix Notes:


Fixed: Traders could sometimes buy items for a higher price than they sold them — resulting in an instant gold loop. That loophole is now closed.  
Added: Passive regeneration for key buildings and structures to improve long-term defense and stability.  
Improved: Increased the chance of spider spawns in the Deadwoods — watch your step out there.  
Fixed: Inventory bug where dragging items from equipment slots into vehicle upgrade slots caused inconsistencies.  
Fixed: Deserialization of building save files could cause incorrect HP values — no more phantom weaknesses.  
Fixed: Incorrect spawn points for certain NPCs have been corrected.  


Thanks for reporting and surviving with us — every fix makes the wasteland just a bit more fair.

notes.title: Update v0.6.0.91
notes.content:
Wastelanders, we've got a tiny but powerful update for you!

This small patch introduces a brand-new difficulty attribute that controls how intense incoming waves of enemies are.

We’ve heard your feedback loud and clear — you want more options, whether you're just starting out or you're a seasoned survivor who thrives on punishment. This change lets you tailor the experience to your preferred level of chaos.

Difficulty Settings:

Tourist: 5% horde intensity — for those who want to explore and enjoy the world with minimal threat.  
Rookie: 20% horde intensity — for players easing into the wasteland.  
True Wastelander: 100% horde intensity — our default, balanced survival experience.  
Overlord: 300% horde intensity — for the true hardcore veterans who want to be constantly tested.  


Thanks again for your feedback — we’re doing our best to make Plains of Pain fit every kind of survivor out there.

PS: Servers will be updated and restarted on Monday.

Hey Survivors,
  
It’s been an intense few months — since January, our team has been working day and night, pushing the limits to bring you the most ambitious update we’ve released so far. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/6c337893d99fc80a4d7d944f22067ee6eb826fa6.jpg

      Multiplayer Testing: We've run internal and community-based tests with our Discord members, identifying and squashing issues to ensure a smoother online experience.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/57f3a879d9dd2ef83be75de3c6b4c99efd3975f4.jpg
    Network Optimization: Major strides were made to reduce latency, improve synchronization, and boost overall performance in multiplayer.    New World Locations: We’ve expanded the world with new zones and factions. You’ll encounter friendly traders from OGD, TOS, and the Bandits, and you’ll be able to earn reputation through trading and quests.

We’re incredibly grateful to every one of you following and supporting our journey — your feedback and enthusiasm keep us going. May 10th is just a few days away, and we can’t wait to see you in the new world we’ve built together.

Dev Team

Survivors,
    
We’re thrilled to bring you our latest update, a labor of love crafted with endless late nights and cups of coffee as fuel. This mode unlocks a suite of camera controls, giving you the freedom to unleash your creativity and capture every gritty, raw, and beautiful moment in the wasteland. — The Dev Team

notes.title: 1st anniversary of Plains of Pain + Update v0.5.4
notes.content:
Today marks exactly one year since the release of the first official public alpha version of Plains of Pain. Since then, we've come a long way, refining the game and adding new content. But it's not just us, it's also our community of players who have been supporting us all along the way, bringing us ideas and reporting any issues. For that, we are very grateful and thank every player who has joined us on an adventure into the world of Plains of Pain.
News
This news isn't just an anniversary announcement, it's also a regular update to the game, so we have some news and a few fixes today as well.
Hiding in the Shadows
We've started reworking the temperature factor and how it affects players. So today we're bringing the first major change: if you're in direct sunlight, you'll overheat more. So if you're dressed in heavy armor, expect to use a lot more water than if you're just running around in the sun wearing an Asian or cowboy hat. So with armor, it's a good idea to seek shade a lot to cool off. But in general, the less overheated you are, the less water you use. High temperatures even cause your health to decline.
That's why we also added a temperature acting on the game character, right next to the clock we added in the last update.
Slot machine
We're bringing back the slot machines, but they've been reconfigured. Find them in the world and try your luck. The payouts can be huge, but of course this is entirely down to chance, which is beyond your control.

notes.title: Major Update v0.5
notes.content:
First of all, we would like to thank all the players who play our game or are interested in it. We are thrilled to read positive reviews where we see 100+ hours logged because we know that even though our game is still an alpha version in development, it offers dozens of hours of fun waiting to be discovered in our post-apocalyptic world
Since the previous update, we've been working almost non-stop on the new update, which is mainly in the spirit of Base Building and expanding content related to building in general.
Base Building
In this update, we've focused mainly on building your own base. But it doesn't just stop at building your dream post-apocalyptic hut. You can enrich your base with many different other things such as production objects, defensive units or your own Repeater.
The whole process of building your base and your own NPCs becomes a kind of game within a game.
Modular building
We have enriched our building system with the possibility of modular building. All modular building elements such as walls, floor, ceiling, etc. from a set of wood and rust building elements are available to you immediately* from the start. You can definitely look forward to more building sets in future updates.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/1a29d277f00d6ad9364e826d0849045a7df31512.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/c1828cced6b428384e545aef3c1cae17b2729c91.jpg
* In order to have all the modular building blocks from the start, you must create a new character if you already own the game.
Production objects with their own NPC population
We've also expanded the buildable content to include several new production objects with their own NPC populations, which produce certain types of items or materials for you if you take care of enough stock.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/45f3032c6e2f8e5151f3400138855b472799133a.png
Defence units
Crossbow guards or a very durable melee unit can help you with defending your base.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/5ffba5c3d48cfbf2266f6c0c67b68750ac4c53d4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/279c0edd0b38362b70c5ea7a78f85cf3426e71a5.jpg
Production facilities
We've also added manufacturing objects that give you access to crafting more advanced items like large backpacks, vehicle parts, and ammo. These production objects are the cornerstone for us to expand the ability to produce more items in the future.
You can find building plans for production facilities in the wasteland or at various merchants.
More news
New experimental feature: Trader Auto-Intel
This feature will be especially appreciated by players who like to trade in the game. This is a feature that automatically scans the supply and demand of each trader visited. This allows it to then show you, for each item in your inventory, which trader in the world is the best one to sell or buy the item from.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/6d17ff25cf74b86f9e87863182a2eee73ac7e3ed.png

This feature will be most appreciated by players who are involved in ground cargo delivery, which is a quick and efficient way to get rich!
The bonus of this new experimental feature is that it also displays the so-called TTID (Temporary Trader ID). You can use this in the experimental feature of displaying Points of Interest on the screen by typing the command /traderpoi and the TTID just mentioned in chat, adding the trader's exact location to the screen so you know immediately which direction to go.
The last important piece of information is that it doesn't store the supply and demand of so-called temporary traders - these are the ones you meet completely randomly in the world and their supply is completely unique. Once you leave, you will never meet the traders again and therefore it would not make sense to store their supply.
Starting position in the middle of the map
We decided to move the player's starting position to the middle of the map, which entailed some technical changes to the core game itself, but was very important for future development and new content for the game.
This change will unfortunately affect all current worlds, so we apologize to current players and ask them to delete their old worlds and create new ones to avoid any inconsistency issues with old worlds.
Building and vehicle status display
When managing your base, it's good to see at a glance what the status of, for example, a defensive wall is. You can find this out just by hovering over the object and you are immediately in the picture. The same applies to vehicles.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/bf829d909cf8c3efd5aec767c0cf1652d084c1a5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/2b67ac07a8c83e81fc4ce0978dcf6a7c59de851e.png
Location announcement
We love details and that's why we decided to also implement our idea, which we had for a very long time but there was no time to implement. Now when you arrive at a populated location, it will greet you with its name and a short dystopian melody.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/9a2731f317082e7811a813ef2835094c45261934.png
New Inventory feature: Auto-Stack
When transferring items from inventory to crate, or vice versa, stackable items will now attempt to auto-stack if there is room for them. We know that players were very interested in this feature, so we added it to make inventory management easier.
New Faction - The Last Wastelanders Guild
The neutral faction is no longer called just neutral, but we have given it the name The Last Wastelanders Guild, TLWG for short. Neutral units are already returning attacks to factions, so our sandbox world is in for a bit more fun again.
Changes to Frank and Ron's camp
In the name of The Last Wastelanders Guild (TLWG), we've changed Frank and Ron's introductory quests and dialogue. They will welcome you with open arms and just wait to give you a quest. We've also added an exploded build plan for the Trainster vehicle to their camp so players can get familiar with the vehicles early in the game and build right away. Oh, and Frank and Ron are now androids. You'll find out why in future updates.

notes.title: Major Update v0.4 - Procedurally Generated World
notes.content:
Experience a whole new adventure with a new major game update. It revolves around a procedurally generated world that you can - rather have to - explore in order to survive!
We've been working really hard to bring you a brand new major game update. We have a lot of good news and news for you, so let's take a look.

Procedurally Generated World
The most important part of the whole update is the ability to generate a new world according to a specific seed and selected world size. This option opens up the opportunity for unrepeatable and unique experiences in our wasteland.
Each new world is full of content all over its surface. You can look forward to smaller settlements, larger towns, faction outposts, bandit outposts, nests of various creatures, radioactive zones, zones with toxic air and abandoned bases. In different places, you will find various traders or smugglers with whom you can trade cargo intended for delivery.
As part of the randomization, all merchant offers are also completely random. This means that you need to find the right merchants with prices that are acceptable to you.
Can you explore all 2 billion worlds?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/e58b1d215eaa212bf8c04bb81e61da7315c4b559.png

Maps and seeds
As part of the update, there are two new maps to choose from as templates for generating random worlds:

 Wasteland v0.4 - basic map with lots of different biomes
 Dunes v0.4 - very hard map, only endless plains of sand

You can use these two maps to generate a random world based on the seed. As a result, this means that you can generate twice as many worlds - i.e. 4 billion.
We added this option mainly because we want to add more different maps to generate in the future.

Skill Tasks
We have reworked many tasks. We removed some, added others. We mainly focused on tasks related to increasing the Skill cap. Find the right people and complete their tasks to increase the limit of the Skill you want to upgrade.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/2c9a1fc20878ddc5362d19367c5b3a5c206ac9eb.png

More news

 vehicles now reflect their status in maximum speed and fuel consumption. If your car is already smoking, it means that it will drive significantly slower and use much more fuel.
 we added a new sniper rifle
 we added a new type of Gold Nuts as a medium rare currency between Rust and Wolfram Nuts
 a new Map item that reveals a new location of a certain type on your map
 new crafting options (shotgun ammo, binoculars, and more)
 new vehicle construction plan (Snailwagon)
 automatically pick up items from the crate if they fit in your inventory
 hundreds of new avatars for traders

notes.title: Major Update v0.3: Skills, XP, Levels
notes.content:
Skills, XP, Levels
There are a lot of hidden mechanisms in the game, which the player did not have the opportunity to influence in any way. However, that is changing today! With the new Skills system, you can upgrade your character to best suit your play style.

Skills are represented as personality types. So, for example, such a more passive skill Smuggler reduces the purchase prices from merchants, at the same time increases the purchase value of items, and as a bonus gets more items from built buildings that produce different items according to the type of building. On the other hand, for example, the skill Furious Berserker is more suitable for fighting types of players who want a high chance of a critical hit that guarantees extreme damage to the enemy.

We divided the skill benefits between 10 "personalities" so that they complement each other.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/c16451c765e4c1d6031328455bd4a49572e32f31.png
You upgrade these skills with Skill Points, which you gain with each new level. As it is probably clear to everyone, each new level needs a certain number of experience points (XP), which you get for eliminating enemies, completing quests or mining various materials.
Overall, this new system adds a whole new layer of fun to the game, and we'll be expanding it again with more content in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/1b03934f3c3c36c7e33b0e6af1a0fe51178d8224.jpg

More news
In addition to the Skill system, we've added various other things to the game.

New Playable Character
We want each player to choose the character they like the most, so we've added another playable character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/9b44df3a2028b413daed89301cb0368c47dd1d8f.png

Map Zoom
The player now has the ability to zoom in and out on the map, so he can have a better overview of the situation around him. The game also includes a hidden option to zoom in and out of the mini-map.

Auto run
We added the autorun option because the community requested it.

Automatically open inventory
To save keystrokes, we've added an option to turn on automatic inventory opening. Practically speaking, this means that when you open a crate or visit a merchant, your inventory will automatically open to the context menu. This option can be turned off in Settings.

Key bindings
We know you've been asking for this for a long time, so we've finally added it.

Volume Control
We've added the ability to control overall volume and music volume.

Control Help
We also focused on helping novice players, so we added basic game controls to the screen so that even a complete beginner would know how to open the inventory, map or crafting book. This option can be turned off in Settings.

Level after player name
Knowing the level of the players around you can come in handy when online bashing, so we've added it after the name.

Firearm Critical Hit
Critical hits were originally only for melee weapons, but we've decided to add them for firearms as well.

New items, recipes, UI news
We've added several new items to the game, and we've also adjusted the difficulty of crafting materials for some firearms. It is now very easy to craft a basic firearm or bandages.

We have modified some other elements in the user interface. For example, when you learn a new blueprint, a flash message pops up on the right side of the screen instead of the character's basic captions.

We've also reworked the NPC character dialog and added the first few NPC avatars so you know who you're monologuing with.

And last but not least, we fixed other bugs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/af0a0965da81317796c322684604c88788568826.png

Known Issues
This is particularly the situation regarding the inventory:

 when you have a backpack with items in your hand (the Hand slot at the bottom of the screen) and exit the game, the items in the backpack will not be saved, because the Hand is not currently an inventory slot, but only used to select the current item that you want to use in some way. We recommend avoiding this situation for now if you don't want to lose items in your backpack.

notes.title: Update v0.2.1
notes.content:
A few words from the developers

We are constantly working on the game. In the last few weeks, we mainly focused on tweaking and adding some animations. We also added new enemies and new items. We have completely redesigned the Craftbook so that it is more clear and generally makes crafting easier for players. We have identified and fixed several major and many minor bugs. The game is almost completely ready for translation into other languages. The game already contains an almost complete translation into our native language (Czech). We will gradually add more languages in the coming months.

New Version 0.2.1
Character Management
We finally added the ability to manage game characters. From now on it is possible to create a new character or switch between them as needed. Practically, this means that you can create, for example, one character for Single Player and other characters for playing with friends, for example.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/562f3605f8bddca4effc47c9c6eb5501472920e4.png
It is also preparation for the upcoming updates, when we will soon start working on RPG elements such as skills and various passive character improvements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/ed17b7c9f62e6e28c8e9f553c501357ad55d20e6.png
This update also adds to the game the option to choose the so-called Online Save Slot when playing online (ie when you are not playing locally or hosting an online world). Practically, this means that you can have up to 3 characters played on one server and switch between them at will before connecting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/2aa9219f5054824a9601e281c64949d1996230c4.png

Map and quests
Discovered locations and custom points on the map and completed tasks are now saved separately for each character in each created world. So you can start a new world and complete all the tasks from the beginning with the same character. When playing online, it is now exactly the same: for each visited server, data about discovered locations, own points on the map and completed tasks is stored separately.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/7212d6842fe1663d9fce75e4b7bbfb3d5d8f5bbc.png

New Game Character
We have added a new playable character to the game. Now you can choose from six different playable characters. So far, all characters have identical properties. This will probably change once we implement various skills and each character will have their specific strengths.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/3307f51cd3878c9f94015615dfafc29385afaf92.png

Other changes

 change of ingredients for the production of some items (e.g. Bandages, First Aid Kits, etc.)
 we added some new items (e.g. Asian hat)
 a new 3D model of a trader who travels randomly around the world
 exhaustion animations for different types of Lowlifes for a better overview of the combat situation
 improved the visual effect of the recoil of firearms
 fixing various bugs


What's next?
We are working hard on version v0.3, which will include skills and new quests. We call the current state of the map working T1, because it offers content that should familiarize the player with the game as best as possible and give him many dozens of hours of fun. After implementing the skills, we plan to focus on T2 content, which will be another piece of the map (which has no static locations yet) and that means a lot of new content - cities, outposts, villages, new enemies, merchants, new weapons, armor, vehicles, etc.

In parallel, we will try to bring other language translations.

Play on our official server
In conclusion, we would like to remind you again that you can play on our official public server, which is called Public Alpha Server EU and you can find it in the game in the Multiplayer section.

You can also chat with us about game development on our Discord. Your feedback is important to us.

notes.title: Plains of Pain: Major Update v0.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/5c2334b18f23730a20abba3f6f97f3aadf64b886.png
At the beginning, we want to thank all the players for their support! We are very appreciative of our community, from whom we have collected a lot of feedback since the first release.

We have been working hard for several months on improvements and new content. Today we are officially releasing a new version of the game (v0.2), in which you can briefly look forward to:

 Over 100 new quests
 GPU and CPU optimization
 Completely redesigned almost all current locations and more new ones added
 Lots of new items (weapons, materials, etc.)
 New types of enemies and NPCs
 New prefixes and suffixes on melee weapons, firearms and wearable items
 Improved vehicles
 UI improvements
 AI improvements
 New sounds and music
 Ability to see players on the map (all or just your team)
 Ability to set an online name that is visible above the player in the world
 Many bug fixes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/7900a66264a69d02da47c57762b6b5936fd19225.png
What's new?
Quests

A brand new feature of the game is the quest system that guides the player through the game and helps show what the game has to offer. You can look forward to personal quests from the inhabitants of the world trying to survive in the wasteland. The difficulty of the tasks is different and it is up to each player in what order they will complete the tasks. Ultimately, quests are not mandatory, it's just another element of fun that the game now offers.

The Network: Repeaters & Air Cargo Delivery

There are so-called signal repeaters scattered around the world that you can repair to restore the signal to the last wireless communication network in existence. This network provides the ability to call various types of cargo transports that will bring you materials for the construction of buildings, gasoline, a faction battle drone or even a finished vehicle.

To call a specific cargo, you need to have a specific item that you can buy from merchants and then use them whenever you want. The only condition is to have a signal.

Buildable Vehicles

Instead of searching the world for vehicles, you now have the option to build them. For starters, we've added the ability to build two vehicles (in the future, it will be possible to build any). Vehicles need special parts that you can buy or find in the wasteland.

Automatic refilling petrol pumps

You can now find repairable petrol pumps in the world. These gas stations had huge stocks of gasoline, but as time went on, the pumps broke down and only after repair, they start pumping gasoline again from the tank for collection.

Outpost Improvements

The outposts also underwent a partial improvement. Not only will you get essential quests and information in the OGD Outpost, but we've also added a new type of battle drone that factions will only deploy when the Outpost is at a certain level of alarm. As the alarm increases, the faction also deploys more difficult units. Keep this in mind when planning your attack! A long siege can be very difficult, but it also gives you the most loot and loyalty to your faction.

Health Bars & damage numbers

At the beginning of the game, it is good to know how weapons work against different enemies. That's why we've added health bars, damage numbers, and a name* above enemies. This function can be turned off in the settings, which will certainly be appreciated by hardcore players.

* the name is disabled by default for enemies, it is active by default for interactive NPCs

Stamina bar

As part of the UI redesign, we decided to make a very visible Stamina bar, which will now appear next to the HAND slot when stamina is drawn. It will also light up red if you can no longer attack with melee weapons or sprint.

Prefixes & Suffixes on Weapons and Clothing
We have implemented randomly generated prefixes and suffixes with various bonus properties. E.g. greater damage, increased resistance, increased range, greater armor penetration, etc.

EU Multiplayer Server

Those who want to experience the real experience of our game can rejoice in the fact that we have launched the first server for Europe, which is publicly available and anyone can play on it. Even though it is still a test server from our point of view, we consider it permanent and we launched it mainly for you, for our players, for the community.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/ab869c0d92ebe9e44f7c76f8360680d82068eaca.png
More news
Here are the new game features that the player community asked us for the most, and we are happy to implement them!

Stealth mode
Even though it's harder for enemies to detect you at night, they detect you 50% harder when crouching is used.
Crouching also gives you the possibility to hide, for example, behind a rock during a firefight.

Scope view
The hunting rifle and the Binoculars offer the option of ultra zoom, so you can see very well what is happening in the distance.

Gamepad support (beta)
We've completely reworked the game's input system and this has opened up the possibility to add gamepad support as well. While this feature is still under development, we welcome your feedback.

Keyboard auto-binding
The classic WASD control automatically adapts to the keyboard layout for your country.

Lootable Dead Trees
You can now get insects or sticks from dead trees.

Cargo Ground-Deliveries
There are certain traders in the game that mediate the ground delivery of cargo. Find them, work for them and earn in-game currency quickly.

Vehicle Repair
Vehicles can now be repaired using a hammer.

Categorized building plans
Just as the Craftbook is categorized, the Blueprints are now categorized.

Loyalty limits for trading in Outposts
In outposts for some things you need a certain loyalty, you can now see this with an item, as well as now you can see how much loyalty you get for trading a certain item.

Flash messages
Quick messages are displayed when the player picks up an item directly from the world (not from a crate), so they can immediately see what they picked up. In the same way, instant messages show a warning when the loyalty level is low, which can be fatal if you are in the Outpost, for example. In the messages you will also learn that someone has joined your game.

Overheating icon
A new survival icon will appear if the player overheats, causing health loss. Watch for overheating. Prevention is to take off things that overheat you and replace them with those that have good Heat Resistance.

List of resolutions in Settings
Now you can choose from a wide range of resolutions compatible with your monitor.

"Q" to close all game windows
You can now close all windows at once with the "Q" key.

Quick slots
Now you can assign things to the quick slot just by moving the mouse over them and pressing the quick slot number - keys 1,2,3 and 4.

Signal Icon
A new signal icon will appear next to the survival icons if you have a signal, meaning you can call in any of the air cargo.

Calculated Loyalty Level
For a better overview, we have added a specific loyalty level number to the current faction.


PS: We are very sorry for any typos in the text, we are full of emotion from this moment, when we have been waiting for a long time, when we will present to you everything that we have prepared for you!
- Your developers

notes.title: Beta Version of the Upcoming Major Update v0.2 is Available
notes.content:
We have a major update ready for you. The official release date of the update is set for Aug 1st, 2023. Details of what's new in the game will be revealed on the day of release.

We also have good news for those who already own Plains of Pain, as we've released an RC version of the upcoming major update, which you can now download and enjoy to the fullest!

Beta version can be found as: public-test - RC v0.2

Guide how to switch to public-test - RC v0.2

Go to steam game library, get to properties for Plains of Pain and in Beta section choose "Public Test RC 0.2.", the new update will start downloading, after that, when you enter the game, log in our public server in Multiplayer option, or enjoy Single player.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43308742/4e6d56077ae0f2b3c7eb44e09683c5101cde1a35.jpg

Important Warning
Please note that character and world saves are not compatible with the new version (v0.2) and will be overwritten when the game is updated, as we have made some changes to the game world.

Please give us feedback
We'd love your feedback, join our Discord or use the Steam Community for your questions.

For those interested in quick little news regarding Plains of Pain, you can follow our Twitter account.
